basis: Fresh candidate Ghidra/P-Code equality, exact AArch64 instruction and relocation parity, two reproducible Docker builds, matching KCFI type ID, strict Joern scope/slice using a versioned analysis-only noinline compatibility view derived from the Docker source tree, and existing passing fp_goodix host coverage.
limitations: This is static/offline function-level evidence; hardware behavior on NX809J remains unverified.

The promotion does not claim that the remaining unpromoted fp_goodix functions are complete.
